visual_review.reviewer: site/presentation integrator (model agent); model-agent review, not human review
observations: All nine final screenshots were opened and viewed as images; tall mobile pages were viewed in full as tiled column sheets. This record replaces the fc51bb9 record after the pre-merge scope corrections (two passes after a read-only audit) and the final build_site.py and docs build of those corrections, committed together with this record. 3 screenshots (catalog-mobile.png, network-mobile.png, sources-mobile.png) are byte-identical to the previously inspected ones; the six changed ones were viewed again. A last rebuild of the site data (panel update 4 wording) produced byte-identical screenshots, and this record carries that final run's date and source hashes.

Desktop and mobile home pages show the 8/8 completion count with the not-a-percentage note, the corrected summary (supports meeting R, observables with ||A||<=1, C' on the cover and c'_site on regions, BC1 at tau=+-10^-8 only, the AX2 node at tau=10^-8 and s=1, the BD1 model scope, F1-only area parity, the l1=l2 grid of the BD2 sign and the not-attempted ledger sentence), the corrected applicability statement, the eight accepted-within-scope result cards and the four reader paths; cards wrap at 390 px without clipping or overlap.

The result page (BA1) shows the reviewed conclusion, model, producers and direction (forward + reverse, paired), derivation steps, applications, limitations, evidence links, the collapsed source inventory (102 files), the review binding and the corrected applicability statement.
The sub-rounds page shows four sub-round cards (sub-round 4 labelled Applications stage), each with 2 of 2 investigations reviewed, its selection note and its panel-update link.

The applications page shows all eighteen recorded application rows: twelve with Transfer, Recorded obstruction and Partial transfer badges and six with the Not attempted (pending) badge, under the intro sentence stating that not-attempted entries are planning candidates that no investigation ran and that nothing is claimed for them; equations in code blocks, outcomes, models and bound evidence links; the two-plaquette row states the l1=l2 grid, the D=8 width and the D=6 widths.
The sources page (after search, lens filter and reset) shows 33 of 33 source records with reading depth, use and limits; no horizontal overflow on the long mobile page (unchanged screenshot).
The catalog element shows the single HNM-C-BA1 card after the contribution-id search; the network element shows the selected r33-ba1 node with its nine direct relations (unchanged screenshots).
The figures page shows the five experiment-setup images, each loaded, with its presentation-only caption and figure-source link, and the corrected applicability statement.
Cosmetic, inherited conventions only, not defects: catalog cards join limitation sentences with "; " and the network detail shows the raw verdict string accepted_within_scope.
